exercise.name: Incline Machine Chest Press
library_steps: Set the seat so the handles start near your upper chest.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
exercise.one_line_summary: Reclined on a 30 deg machine seat, palms-forward handles at the upper chest. Picture 1: handles just above the upper chest, forearms vertical; picture 2: arms pressed up and forward, nearly straight.

setup.target: Back pad ~30 deg; handles start level with the upper chest.

movement.end: 118 deg, arms up over the shoulders

muscles.emg: Clavicular pectoralis highest at a 30 deg incline (S1); 122-124 % MVIC at 30-45 deg (S2).
muscles.role: Library primary 'chest'; the incline biases the upper chest, so the upper mask is primary.
muscles.surface: Upper front of the chest below the collarbone.

muscles.emg: Sternal head still works but less as the incline rises (S2).
Anterior deltoid activity rises with incline (S1).

muscles.role: Keep the trunk still against the back pad.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Lower back arches to make it a flat press.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Changes the press angle away from the upper chest (S1).

sources.citation: Rodriguez-Ridao D, Antequera-Vique JA, Martin-Fuentes I, Muyor JM. Effect of five bench inclinations on the electromyographic activity of the pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, and triceps brachii during the bench press exercise. Int J Environ Res Public Health. 2020;17(19):7339.
sources.what_it_gave: Bench inclinations 0-60 deg: 30 deg gives the highest clavicular pectoralis activity; anterior deltoid rises with incline.

sources.citation: Lauver JD, Cayot TE, Scheuermann BW. Influence of bench angle on upper extremity muscular activation during bench press exercise. Eur J Sport Sci. 2016;16(3):309-316.
sources.what_it_gave: Upper pectoralis 122-124 % MVIC at 30 and 45 deg incline (mid concentric); lower pectoralis ~100 % at -15 deg decline, 72 % at 45 deg.

sources.citation: Muyor JM, Rodriguez-Ridao D, Oliva-Lozano JM. Effect of grip width and grip orientation on muscle activity during the seated chest press. J Hum Kinet. 2023;87:23-34.
sources.what_it_gave: Seated machine chest press EMG: clavicular pectoralis ~30 % MVIC with a neutral grip, anterior deltoid ~24 %; grip orientation changes the split between the pec heads.

clip_check.target: 45 deg, elbows below the shoulders -> 118 deg, arms up over the shoulders (start 35-55, end 105-125)

clip_check.check: Machine parts meet the hands/feet; levers keep their length
clip_check.target: moving rod lengths equal at start and end (+-1 cm)
